description:
Litecoin, one of the oldest and most trusted cryptocurrencies, is often called the silver to Bitcoin’s gold, and in this video, we dive deep into what makes it unique even after more than a decade of existence. From its creation in 2011 by former Google engineer Charlie Lee to its role as a faster, cheaper, and more accessible version of Bitcoin, this episode breaks down everything you need to know. We’ll explain how Litecoin was designed to solve Bitcoin’s scalability issues, how its mining process works, and what makes it stand out in speed, supply, and efficiency. You’ll also learn about Litecoin’s halving events, real-world use cases, and how it continues to serve as a reliable payment system trusted by exchanges, wallets, and even platforms like PayPal. But it’s not all sunshine — we’ll cover its risks, limitations, and the debate over whether Litecoin still has a place in today’s fast-evolving crypto world. By the end, you’ll understand why Litecoin remains one of the most resilient and relevant digital currencies ever created, and how it continues to represent the original vision of crypto — fast, decentralized money for everyone.
